description:
What Impact You'll Have 

 Northstrat a GRVTY company, is seeking a highly skilled Infrastructure Engineer to orchestrate and execute over the air (OTA) software deployments to globally fielded systems in a potentially degraded, disconnected, intermittent, and limited (DDIL) connectivity environment. This engineer will be responsible for automating the deployment and security of software, reducing the need for FSR travel while increasing the operational availability of the fleet. Once the software is live, the infrastructure engineer will monitor its health remotely to preempt failures that could impact mission The ideal candidate will be hands-on, security-focused, and comfortable operating in a hybrid on-premises and cloud environment

 What You'll be Owning 

 

 DevSecOps 

 Strong proficiency with Docker

 
 Writing Dockerfiles

 Building hardened images

 Integrating builds into pipelines

 
 Hands-on Kubernetes experience

 
 Cluster operations

 Workload management

 RBAC

 Networking

 Troubleshooting

 
 Linux Systems Administration

 
 Install, configure, and maintain Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu)

 Manage system services, patching, and updates

 Automate tasks using Bash, Python, or Ansible

 Manage system backups and disaster recovery procedures

 Monitor system performance and troubleshoot production issues

 
 Network Engineering

 
 Troubleshoot and maintain enterprise network infrastructure

 Manage VLANs, routing protocols (BGP, EIGRP), and switching technologies

 Maintain network segmentation and security controls

 Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management

 Monitor network health and performance using SNMP and other tools

 Maintain firewall policies and intrusion prevention systems 1

 
 What You Must Have 

 

 
 A DoD TS/SCI clearance is required

 CompTIA Security+ (or equivalent) or better

 Must have 5+ years of experience in network engineering and systems administration

 Strong Linux administration experience in production environments

 Experience with virtualization platforms

 Knowledge of network security principles and best practices

 Must have the ability to troubleshoot across network and system layers

 Strong hands-on experience with Cisco networking equipment

 
 What Would be Nice to Have 

 

 
 
 
 Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or better

 Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet)

 Experience with monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Nagios, Zabbix)

 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 Scripting experience (Python, Bash)

 


 
 
 

 
  

 Pay Range:  At GRVTY, we understand that compensation is influenced by many factors—such as geographic location, federal contract labor categories, wage rates, prior experience, skillsets, education, and certifications.
We’re proud to offer a work environment that empowers our team to achieve a strong work-life balance. GRVTY provides competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for professional growth.
Our benefits package is designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families, and includes coverage in areas such as healthcare, financial wellness, retirement planning, family assistance, continued education, and paid time off.

 
 The pay range for this position is: $104,000 - $190,000
